'''Calvin Wright (Chapter 6)''' is a special [[ally]] used in scenarios 6-9 of the 2nd Arkham League.

==Card info==
*-2 Maximum [[Sanity]]
*-2 Maximum [[Stamina]]
*+2 All [[Skill check|Skill Checks]]
*+1 [[Focus]]

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Calvin Wright ally used by different scenarios.

[[Category:Allies]]

==Appearances==
Calvin Wright (Chapter 6) appears in the following scenarios:
*[[After the Storm]]
*[[True Terror Begins]]
*[[Chapter 8]]
*[[The Key and the Gate]]
